A post from @trq212 says its author has joined OpenAI after time at Anthropic and describes the move positively toward both teams. The announcement explains a personal wish to contribute to AI products rather than alleging misconduct by the former employer.

The page is a self-reported career announcement, not independent confirmation of role, start date, responsibilities or recruitment terms. The author's product-reach statement is not an audited user count, and the timing of this feed observation differs from the November 25 post timestamp. No contact or employment-related action was taken.
highlights: Observed source is a public social account
Post announces a move from Anthropic to OpenAI
Specific new role and terms are not established
Product user count is not independently audited
Feed observation is later than the post
No inference about hidden motives is supported
